items.title: Torsten Sløk on why AI could be an economic 'miracle drug'
items.summary: Apollo Global Management Partner & Chief Economist Torsten Sløk joins Sozzi Unleashed to discuss how Muse AI and the rise of AI agents could reshape the economy. Sløk explains why he views AI as a potential "miracle drug" for productivity, arguing that the technology could transform how businesses operate, boost economic output, and reshape the labor market. Disclosure: Yahoo is a portfolio company of funds managed by affiliates of Apollo Global Management.
